[SWS_CM_00811] Behavior of
ara::com
when calling
StopOfferService
⌈
After
calling
StopOfferService()
, the
ara::com
in the Skeleton side shall consider this
Service as not offered anymore and therefore requests from any proxy shall be ig-
nored.
⌋
